blocks.text: Use create-retiam for the project with Studio and the complete render config. The engine’s init/create command is a separate basic scaffolder. Static lint catches a limited set of structure, async timing, entity and foreign-API patterns; also run the project’s TypeScript check and verify the result in a browser.

Run these scripts inside a project created with create-retiam. The generator installs dependencies and starts dev by default; --no-start performs the install without launching, and --no-install only creates files.

blocks.text: The manifest’s root test script runs Jest; unit-test runs the standalone TypeScript test entry. Asset download/generation, export, render and gen-index write output. The documentation has its own package scripts in retiam-docs; run npm run build there for its production website.

Studio is available in generated projects and in the engine repository at studio/index.html. It provides a Monaco source editor, live scene preview, inspectors and playback controls. Generated projects use their installed npm engine and their own Studio files. The documentation viewer is a separate application.

The editor starts below the preview. Drag the divider to resize the preview and editor, or dock the editor on the left or right with the layout control. Studio remembers your layout. In a generated single-scene project, the navigation and search are hidden; adding more Scene files under src/scenes/ and reloading reveals the browser.

Edit src/scenes/Retiam.ts, then press Run or Ctrl/Command+Enter to apply and save changes through the development server. Inspectors tune supported geometry, vector, color and easing expressions. Turn off Preserve State to check the animation from a fresh start.

Use npm run dev for editing and npm run preview for the built playback experience. Lint, type-check and inspect keyframes before a final CLI render. config.js supplies CLI render settings; use [the full reference](/export#render-configuration) to set output size, fps and rendering features.

Updating the generator affects new projects. Existing projects keep their own Studio copy; update those files deliberately when adopting Studio fixes. Studio implementation modules are cataloged on the [project map](/project-map).

PlayerControls exposes pause/resume, timeline seeking, stepping, speed and fullscreen around the composer. menu/control utilities provide parameter widgets for application values. They are DOM UI and have different capture behavior from isUI entities rendered by WebGPU.
